results.quote: We present a sorting algorithm for self-delimiting numbers that runs in \(O(k+\frac{N}{logN})\) time and uses _O(N_) bits.

results.bound: \(O(k+\frac{N}{\log N})\) time and \(O(N)\) bits; \(O(1)\)-time rank queries
results.quote: We present an algorithm to compute the dense/competitive rank on a sequence _S_ of length _N_ consisting of _k_ self-delimiting numbers in \(O(k+\frac{N}{logN})\) time using _O(N_) bits and subsequently answer dense/competitive rank queries of a number \(x\in S\) in constant time.
We present an _O(n_)-time and _O(n_)-bit tree-isomorphism algorithm that decides if two given unrooted unlabeled _n_-node trees are isomorphic.

Given two (unrooted) colored n-node trees T_<sub>1</sub> and T_<sub>2</sub>, there is an algorithm that outputs if T_<sub>1</sub> and T_<sub>2</sub> are isomorphic in O(n+b_) time using O(n+b_) bits exactly if the colors of all nodes of T_<sub>1</sub> and T_<sub>2</sub> can be written within O(b_) bits.

Given two colored n-node forests F_<sub>1</sub> and F_<sub>2</sub> with b being the sum of bits to write down the colors of all nodes of F_<sub>1</sub> and F_<sub>2</sub>, there is an algorithm that outputs if F_<sub>1</sub> and F_<sub>2</sub> are isomorphic in linear-time using O(n+b_) bits.
Let G and G' be two maximal outerplanar graphs. We can test isomorphism of G and G' in O(n_) time and bits.
Let G and G' be two partially embedded outerplanar graphs. We can answer if G is isomorphic to G' using O(n_) time and bits.
